items.escena: A small clay portrait tile resting inside a rounded clay shield on a counter
A clay strongbox with its lid ajar, a small clay heart and a tiny clay medical cross glowing softly inside
Four plain clay letter-boxes standing in a row on a counter, a fat clay envelope poised in front of the first one
A clay figure standing behind a counter with both hands resting on a closed clay filing box
A long clay document scroll unrolled on a desk with three of its paragraph bars raised above the surface
A clay balance scale with one small clay cube on each pan, both pans exactly level
A clay hand pressing an open clay stamp down onto a document, the stamp face blank
A chunky clay machine with a slot: a clay file card goes in one side and a stamped clay verdict tile drops out the other, with no clay figure anywhere near it
A clay house with one window shuttered by a small clay panel while the rest of the facade stays open
A clay filing box closed with a chunky clay padlock, a small portrait tile visible through a slot in its lid
A clay hand lifting a file card out of a clay drawer, leaving a clean empty slot in the row
A clay megaphone resting on an open clay platform with a ribbon of speech rising freely from it
